reels.title: GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for everyone

editorial_notes.reasoning: GPT-6's 'Intelligent UI' represents a paradigm shift in multimodal interaction, directly hitting the high-velocity 'multimodal_diffusion' category and serving a mass audience interested in the next generation of user experience.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if your AI didn't just type out answers, but actively built the interface you needed in real-time?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A shapeshifting workbench that instantly rearranges its tools based on exactly what project you are holding.
